text: A soldier raises the Stars and Stripes. The crossing was in December seventeen seventy-six. Only in June seventeen seventy-seven did Congress resolve that the flag would have thirteen stripes and thirteen stars. Which flag, if any, was carried is not known.
spoken_text: A soldier raises the Stars and Stripes. The crossing was in December seventeen seventy-six. Only in June seventeen seventy-seven did Congress resolve that the flag would have thirteen stripes and thirteen stars. Which flag, if any, was carried is not known.
